recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13328; future compatibility wording for StructureDefinition/regex belongs with the Extension Pack or later FHIR-37359 guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-13328 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I change request asking to combine http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/structuredefinition-regex and http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/regex by deprecating structuredefinition-regex and retaining regex.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 6977725bc70491aa5c85db4c7ed54d32f04d42db, corresponding to SVN revision 12722 from the Jira comment. That commit changed the R4 tooling constant from StructureDefinition/structuredefinition-regex to StructureDefinition/regex and removed the old structuredefinition regex extension spreadsheet row.
additional_context: The current combined core source has no structuredefinition-regex, validation-regex, or StructureDefinition/regex source references. source/fhir.ini lists active extension profile inputs but not the old structuredefinition extension spreadsheet. The Extension Pack now contains only StructureDefinition/regex, marked retired/deprecated with a reason pointing to ElementDefinition.constraint. Later Published issue FHIR-37359, already represented on the combined branch, removed active core regex extension use in favor of constraints.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is needed because the duplicate extension is absent from current core and later decisions make reintroducing active regex extension content inappropriate.

related_jiras.note: Later Published FHIR-I decision removed the regex extension as an active core validation mechanism and confirms that current core should not reintroduce it.

evidence_items.summary: Active profile inputs remain listed, but combined-branch source has no structuredefinition-regex or StructureDefinition/regex source references.
evidence_items.learned: There is no current core build source location where the duplicate regex extension remains to be corrected.

evidence_items.summary: The Extension Pack defines only StructureDefinition/regex and marks it retired/deprecated with a reason recommending constraints.
evidence_items.learned: The surviving compatibility artifact is outside core and already reflects later retirement, while structuredefinition-regex is absent.

evidence_items.summary: Later Published issue resolved to remove the regex extension in favor of constraints; the combined branch already contains the cleanup commit.
evidence_items.learned: Later final WG action confirms that current core should not restore active regex extension content for FHIR-13328.
